description:
President Donald Trump on Sunday provided a new reason to justify his proposal to build a 250-foot triumphal arch directly across Arlington National Cemetery, saying the structure would double as a “top grade Military Complex.”

The facility on what military veterans argue overlooks hallowed ground would “house, store, and have the rapid ability to use large numbers of drones, plus Snipers, on both the roof and plaza areas, and additionally have and hold large quantities of sniper ammunition in storage,” Trump wrote in a post on Truth Social.

title: Trump: Triumphal arch will be used for drones, snipers & ammo

author: CNN
description:
President Donald Trump said Saturday he plans to create an “AI Force” and name an AI czar as the government faces growing calls to impose guardrails on the rapid development of artificial intelligence. The president, writing on Truth Social, repeated his assessment that fears over AI amount to a hoax and also seemed to acknowledge some of the risks the technology presents, saying, “we will also be looking for BAD, and we can do that, very easily, with our already existing Criminal and Civil Justice System.”

The Trump administration will convene a high-level event on AI on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly on Wednesday, multiple sources familiar with the matter previously told CNN. A day later, several technology executives will attend a state dinner at the White House as part of Chinese leader Xi Jinping’s visit to Washington, according to a White House official. A White House official also said that AI safety would be “on the agenda” when Trump meets with Xi.

0:00 Trump stat
title: Trump calls AI fears 'hoax' but says he'll form 'AI force' & name 'AI czar'

author: CNN
description:
Ukraine carried out its largest ever drone attack on the Russian capital and the surrounding area as voting in parliamentary elections entered the final day. 

The Russian Ministry of Defense said in a statement on Sunday that more than 1,900 drones, eight guided aerial bombs, eight cruise missiles and four rockets were shot down overnight. That tally makes the attack Ukraine’s largest ever, although Kyiv did not confirm the exact number of drones and projectiles it fired. 

CNN's Paula Hancocks has the details while CNN military analyst James Stavridis and CNN global and political affairs analyst Sabrina Singh weigh in on the impact of Ukraine's military move. Also, Russia expert Jill Dougherty explains why Putin held elections as the war with Ukraine grinds on. 

0:00 Videos show the aftermath of Ukraine's largest ever strike inside Russia 
2:33 Ex-NATO commander offers 'congratulations' to Ukraine on its attack 
3:57 What can we expect from Trump's upcoming meeting with Zelensky?
title: Ukraine launches its largest attack on Moscow: Military expert reacts

author: CNN
description:
An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent shot and wounded a man from Venezuela who was working as a DoorDash driver Sunday in Texas’ capital, city officials confirmed, with protests erupting at the scene against President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown.

The man shot Sunday in Austin was identified as Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, 28, by Kate Lincoln-Goldfinch, an immigration lawyer who said she is representing his family. Garces Perez is an undocumented immigrant who had a final order for removal, the Department of Homeland Security said. He was stable and “in federal custody pending removal,” DHS said.

“What we do understand is that he previously held a valid work permit and that, based on the information available to us, he entered the United States lawfully,” Lincoln-Goldfinch said in a statement.
